result.instructions: Tools for DeskTime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is working right now, and how productive has the team been today?"; "Show yesterday's DeskTime data for Anna: hours, productivity and the apps she used."; "Which projects did the team track time on this week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DeskTime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run desktime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run desktime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run desktime_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. desktime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: desktime_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The DeskTime company account this API key belongs to: company name, work schedule (start, end, duration, working days), tracking window and account timezone. GET /company.

tools.name: desktime_list_employees
tools.title: List employees with tracking data
tools.description: All employees of the company with their tracked time for a day, week or month: arrived/left, online, desk, at-work, productive time, productivity and efficiency, group. Starts at `date` (default today); `period` is day (default), week or month. Returned a page at a time (employee-days, sorted by date then id). Needs an admin's key. GET /employees. This is employee monitoring (personal) data: ask for one day at a time and only what the user needs.

date.description: The day to read, yyyy-mm-dd, in the DeskTime account's timezone. Default: today.

period.description: Window starting at `date`: day (default), week or month.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: desktime_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee day summary
tools.description: One employee's summary for one day: name, email, group, arrived/left, late, online/offline/desk/at-work/productive time (seconds), productivity and efficiency. Without projects or apps; see desktime_get_employee_projects / _apps / _full for those. GET /employee/basic. This is employee monitoring (personal) data: ask for one day at a time and only what the user needs.

id.description: DeskTime employee id (from desktime_list_employees). Omit for the user the API key belongs to. Other employees need an admin key.

date.description: The day to read, yyyy-mm-dd, in the DeskTime account's timezone. Default: today.

tools.name: desktime_get_employee_projects
tools.title: Get employee day with projects
tools.description: One employee's day summary plus the projects and tasks they tracked time on that day. GET /employee/projects. This is employee monitoring (personal) data: ask for one day at a time and only what the user needs.

id.description: DeskTime employee id (from desktime_list_employees). Omit for the user the API key belongs to. Other employees need an admin key.

date.description: The day to read, yyyy-mm-dd, in the DeskTime account's timezone. Default: today.

tools.name: desktime_get_employee_apps
tools.title: Get employee day with apps
tools.description: One employee's day summary plus the apps, websites and titles they used that day, with durations and productivity class. Lists longer than 200 entries are cut. GET /employee/apps. This is employee monitoring (personal) data: ask for one day at a time and only what the user needs.

id.description: DeskTime employee id (from desktime_list_employees). Omit for the user the API key belongs to. Other employees need an admin key.

date.description: The day to read, yyyy-mm-dd, in the DeskTime account's timezone. Default: today.

tools.name: desktime_get_employee_full
tools.title: Get employee day with projects and apps
tools.description: One employee's day summary plus both the tracked projects/tasks and the apps/websites used that day. The largest reply: prefer the narrower tools. Lists longer than 200 entries are cut. GET /employee. This is employee monitoring (personal) data: ask for one day at a time and only what the user needs.

id.description: DeskTime employee id (from desktime_list_employees). Omit for the user the API key belongs to. Other employees need an admin key.

date.description: The day to read, yyyy-mm-dd, in the DeskTime account's timezone. Default: today.

annotations.title: Get employee day with projects and apps

tools.name: desktime_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Active (not archived) projects of the company with their tasks: id, name, creation time and tasks. Returned a page at a time. GET /projects.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: desktime_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: WRITE: create a new project (and optionally one task in it) in the company's DeskTime account. Not idempotent: a second call with the same name makes another project. Returns the new project's id, url and tasks. POST /create-project.

task.description: Optional name of a first task to create in the project.

tools.name: desktime_start_project
tools.title: Start project timer
tools.description: WRITE: start tracking time on a project (and optionally a task) for the user the API key belongs to, by project name. This changes that user's tracked time and may switch away from the project currently running. Returns {started: true|false}. GET /start-project.

project.description: Exact name of the project to start (see desktime_list_projects).

task.description: Optional exact name of the task inside the project.

tools.name: desktime_stop_project
tools.title: Stop project timer
tools.description: WRITE: stop tracking time on a project (and optionally a task) for the user the API key belongs to, by project name. Returns {stopped: true|false}. GET /stop-project.

project.description: Exact name of the running project to stop.

task.description: Optional exact name of the task inside the project.
